question:
Complete the sentence with an appropriate synonym of the word mentioned in the bracket.

If you're feeling brave, try this ___________ (savoury) dish made by me.
solution:
The correct answer is: **salty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"savoury"** refers to food that is salty or spicy rather than sweet. (स्वादिष्ट)

 
 
• **Example: **Her savoury dishes are always a hit at family gatherings.
 
 
 
• **"Salty"** is a term that describes food seasoned with or tasting of salt. (नमकीन)
 
 
• **Example: **The soup was a bit too salty for my taste.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that a synonym for "savoury" is "salty".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **salty**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stale **(बासी): Food that is no longer fresh.

 
 
• **Example:** The bread has gone stale, so we should throw it away.
 
 
 
• **Stinky **( दुर्गंधयुक्त): Something that has a strong, unpleasant smell.
 
 
• **Example: **The garbage bin is stinky, it needs to be emptied.
 
 
 
• **Stenchy** (दुर्गंधित): Having a very strong, unpleasant smell.
 
 
• **Example:** The stenchy locker room made it hard to breathe.
